1. Someone took a plane to the country Ecuador.

2. Ginny took a plane to Ecuador.

3. Ginny recently quit her job.

4. The job Ginny recently quit was at a law firm.

5. The law firm where Ginny previously worked was dramatic.

6. Some of the drama at Ginny's former law firm job was preventable.

7. Ginny thought she would have a quiet vacation when she flew to Ecuador.
